label: copy phase: input 3 (late recall) when the next output is j ("3 j" bigram)
explanation: Only fires in the copy phase (never during original input or at <DEL>), and almost only when the fed-back input is the digit 3 (94% of mass; in_tok j gives the remaining ~6%). Since copy-phase inputs are always repeats, in_first is always 0 here. The strongest activations come when the original sequence had 3 followed by j, so the model is reading 3 and about to output j. These cluster near the end of long sequences (recall_idx >= 3, mostly L = 8-9, to_go 0-2), and the top examples are k 3 j at positions 6-8. With recall_idx >= 3, the 3-then-j predicate has dev precision ~0.79 but covers only ~54% of mass. Weaker activations (mostly < 0.3 of max) also occur on copy-phase input 3 with other next outputs (t, p, k, ...), mainly at late recall positions, and their rate rises with recall_idx and with how many digits the sequence has. Copy-phase 3 alone covers 94% of mass at precision ~0.04. Does not fire on early recalls (recall_idx <= 2), on 3 j bigrams early in the copy phase, or on any other input token.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
